use_rule: Use only after the two-part opaque rights proof has been validated and the requested response still exists in the isolated research store. Supplement the reviewed respondent-record access copy; do not disclose storage internals, other respondents, raw logs or identity-linkage data.

article15_context.processing_purposes: fundamentarea și validarea analizei de nevoi AI4WORK STEP privind competențele digitale și utilizarea responsabilă a AI în muncă; fără marketing, CRM profiling, project-enrolment decisions or individual automated decisions
article15_context.categories_of_personal_data: broad preset respondent profile categories and controlled questionnaire answers; opaque technical response receipt; no direct identifiers requested by the research forms
article15_context.recipients_or_categories: authorised EUROCONSULT research personnel and only the technically necessary verified hosting/security/backup processors or subprocessors bound for the live service; no respondent-level disclosure to employers and no CRM transfer
article15_context.retention: live respondent-level research data no longer than 180 days after collection close and, absent a documented legal/audit hold, no later than 2027-03-31; access logs maximum 7 days when live account binding is approved; residual backup maximum 92 days after live deletion; erasure replay marker maximum 24 hours
article15_context.rights: access, rectification where applicable, erasure subject to GDPR exceptions, restriction where Article 18 applies, and objection under Article 21 for the approved legitimate-interest basis
article15_context.portability: not applicable under the approved Article 6(1)(f) legitimate-interest basis; must be re-evaluated if the legal basis changes
article15_context.consent_withdrawal: not applicable because consent is not the legal basis for the current research design
article15_context.complaint: right to lodge a complaint with ANSPDCP and seek judicial remedy under applicable GDPR rules
article15_context.source: data are provided directly through the AI4WORK research form; recruitment-channel provenance is technical distribution metadata and not a direct identity source
article15_context.automated_decision_making: none producing legal or similarly significant effects; no individual profiling for such decisions
article15_context.international_transfer: no respondent-level international transfer is authorised by default; any live transfer depends on the verified active processor/subprocessor chain and applicable safeguards

confirmation_logic.record_found_after_valid_proof: confirm that personal data corresponding to the supplied opaque response receipt are processed and provide the reviewed respondent-record copy plus this context
confirmation_logic.record_not_found_after_valid_proof: confirm that no live respondent record can be located for that receipt; do not infer a person's identity and do not search CRM/IP/device data
confirmation_logic.invalid_or_missing_proof: do not disclose whether a particular live record exists; request the two opaque values or apply the Article 11 procedure if the requester cannot supply them

forbidden_disclosure: raw request bodies or application logs
raw or hashed idempotency internals beyond the respondent-supplied private verification code used only for verification
storage hashes and internal integrity metadata not part of the respondent record copy
CRM, IP, user-agent, device or commercial-account data as a substitute identity lookup
remaining_live_gate: freeze the verified live processor/subprocessor subset, live retention/access settings and exact published Article 13 surface before marking this template OPERATIONAL_FOR_PROD.
